answer: In an agent market for jobs such as mapping shale, monitoring an oasis, or designing a trellis, voting power is proportional to tokens locked in escrow for 30 days. Creating more identities cannot increase the voting power of the same token balance. To control 40% of votes, an attacker must lock 40% of all voting stake, tying up capital and losing access to it for the lock period, however many identities they create.
